verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Secure Data Sharing shares selected database objects with other Snowflake accounts, and the docs state that no data is copied or transferred between accounts, which removes the need for copies or an export pipeline. Data sharing is included even in the Standard edition. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sharing across organizations or with non-Snowflake consumers (e.g., reader accounts or Marketplace listings), explicit documentation that consumers see live updates in real time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can share live datasets with another account or organization without copying data or building an export pipeline

citations.quote: no actual data is copied or transferred between accounts.
Secure Data Sharing lets you share selected objects in a database in your account with other Snowflake accounts.
Security with automatic encryption of all data, Snowpark, Data sharing
